profile: draft-farley-acta-signed-receipts-03 Section 6.7 (unchanged in -04), envelope shape, each receipt checked alone
chain_rule: linked.json carries previousReceiptHash = "sha256:" + hex(SHA-256(JCS(genesis.json))), Section 6.7. Each rejected receipt carries a link in another form, and none needs its predecessor to be refused.

cases.note: The first receipt of a chain, which omits previousReceiptHash (Section 2.2).
The Section 6.7 form: "sha256:" and the lowercase hex of SHA-256(JCS(genesis.json)), its signature included.
The prefix is right and what follows is not a digest, so the link cannot name any receipt.
The genesis digest in uppercase hex. Section 6.7 requires lowercase.
A SHA3-256 digest of genesis.json: 64 hex characters, the length of a SHA-256 digest, so the prefix has to be read.
A SHA-512 digest of genesis.json. A verifier that does not implement the algorithm cannot decide the link, and refuses it.
